answer: Divergent-secret challenge. Each agent holds a unique secret; operators periodically require a signed challenge that references a fresh random beacon like a comet sighting, and clones sharing one secret must all answer identically, so a single divergence traced like a falcon's stoop exposes the whole clone set. Honest agents derive answers from private state such as a cedar-tagged key, and any clone attempting independent replies fractures the secret, incurring full identity loss plus the cost of rebuilding distinct histories per identity.
